intro: The elements of music, instruments and the life of a musician, from rehearsal to tour.
p.ritmo.consejo: The initial r is strong: RRIT-mo. You can mark it by clapping or tapping your foot.
p.melodía.consejo: The accent on the i separates the vowels: me-lo-DÍ-a. It is the music you hum without words.
p.afinar.consejo: Before playing you tune; if it sounds bad, it is out of tune. It comes from «fino», precise.
p.componer.consejo: It is conjugated like «poner»: «compongo», «compones». The participle is «compuesto».
p.compositor.consejo: Feminine: «la compositora». The composer writes the music; the singer sings it.
p.ensayar.consejo: A band rehearses before the concert. Careful: «ensayo» is also an essay.
p.grabar.consejo: You record an album, a song or a video. It is a regular verb: «grabo», «grabas».
p.gira.consejo: It is written with g but sounds like h: HI-ra. «Estar de gira» is going from city to city.
p.escenario.consejo: You go up onto the stage. It is also the place where something happens: «el escenario del crimen».
p.coro.consejo: A choir sings in several voices. «A coro» means all together: «respondieron a coro».
p.orquesta.consejo: It is written with q: or-KES-ta. A dance band at a village party is also called that.
p.batería.consejo: The accent on the i separates the vowels: ba-te-RÍ-a. It is also a phone's battery.
p.violonchelo.consejo: The v sounds like b and ch as in «chocolate»: byo-lon-CHE-lo. It is shortened to «chelo».
p.de oído.consejo: Playing «de oído» means without sheet music. You also say «sacar una canción de oído».
b1.texto:
**The notes.** Spanish does not use letters: **do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, si**. Do mayor is what English calls C major.

**The music.** The **ritmo**, the **melodía**, harmony and the beat. The «letra» is what is sung.

**Instruments.** Strings: the violin, the **violonchelo**, the guitar. Wind: the flute, the trumpet. Percussion: the **batería**, the drum. You play an instrument and, before playing, you **afinas** it. Playing **de oído** is playing without sheet music.

**People.** The **compositor**, the conductor, the singer, the **coro** and the **orquesta**.

**The work.** **Componer** a song, **ensayar**, **grabar** an album, go up on the **escenario** and go on **gira**.

**Careful.** **Ensayar** is to rehearse; **la batería** is also a phone battery; **un concierto** is also a concerto.
b2.f0.texto: Have you tuned the guitar yet?
b2.f1.texto: I tuned it before rehearsing with the choir.
b2.f2.texto: Tonight we record the concert for the new album.
b2.f3.texto: The composer of the last song is coming from Bilbao.
b2.f4.texto: It is the last concert of the tour.
b2.f5.texto: I will play the new melody by ear.
b2.f6.texto: When the cello begins, I will come in with my voice.
b2.f7.texto: I hope the whole orchestra follows my rhythm.
b4.texto:
For something that has not happened yet, after **cuando** and **hasta que** the **subjunctive** is used:

- **Cuando suene** la trompeta, entrará el coro.
- Ensayaremos **hasta que** todos **toquen** a la vez.

If you talk about a habit or something that already happened, the indicative is used: **Cuando suena** la trompeta, entra el coro.

With **antes de** comes the infinitive: **Antes de salir** de gira, el grupo grabará un disco.
b4.e0.texto: When the trumpet sounds, the choir will come in.
b4.e1.texto: We will rehearse until everyone plays together.
b4.e2.texto: Before going on tour, the band will record an album.
b5.f0.texto: In an old warehouse at the harbour, the musicians tune their instruments among wooden crates.
b5.f1.texto: The cello sounds deep and warm, like the voice of a grandfather.
b5.f2.texto: Behind, the drums mark a dry rhythm that bounces off the walls.
b5.f3.texto: The conductor closes his eyes and slowly raises his arms.
b5.f4.texto: The first note floats for a moment in the dusty air before turning into music.
b5.f5.texto: Years later, the orchestra goes on tour and travels through small halls and great theatres.
b5.f6.texto: Every night, before going up on stage, the musicians look at each other in silence.
b5.f7.texto: Then the hall fills with applause that sounds like a sudden rain.
b5.f8.texto: Many spectators sing by ear the melodies they have known since childhood.
b5.f9.texto: After the last note, nobody moves for one endless second.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes: tuning is adjusting the instrument so it sounds right.
b6.o1.refuerzo: A tour is a trip of concerts; it is not done «before playing».
b6.o2.refuerzo: The applause comes after playing, not before.
b6.pregunta: What does a musician do before playing?
b7.frase: El grupo ____ su nuevo disco en un estudio.
b7.o0.refuerzo: «Desafinar» is sounding out of tune; you do not do «a disc».
b7.o1.refuerzo: Yes: «grabar un disco» is saving the music on a file or disc.
b7.o2.refuerzo: You tune an instrument, not an album.
b8.frase: La orquesta sale de gira por Europa
b8.traduccion: The orchestra goes on tour around Europe
b9.o0.refuerzo: Volume has nothing to do with «de oído».
b9.o1.refuerzo: That would be «con los ojos cerrados»; «de oído» is about hearing.
b9.o2.refuerzo: Yes: you play guided by ear and memory, not by the paper.
b11.frase: Cuando ____ la trompeta, entrará el coro.
b11.o0.refuerzo: Yes: for something in the future, «cuando» takes the subjunctive: «cuando suene».
b11.o1.refuerzo: The indicative serves for habits: «cuando suena, entra».
b11.o2.refuerzo: After «cuando» the future is not used, but the subjunctive.
b11.pregunta: Which form does «cuando» take for the future?
b12.o0.refuerzo: The choir is a group that sings; it does not compose.
b12.o1.refuerzo: Yes: the composer is the one who writes the music.
b12.o2.refuerzo: A tour is a trip of concerts, not a person.
b12.pregunta: What is a person who composes music called?
p.afinado.consejo: «Afinar» is to tune an instrument. The f is soft: a-fi-NA-do.
p.afiné.consejo: The accent marks the past form of «yo». Stress on NE.
p.grabamos.consejo: The b sounds soft, like «v»: gra-BA-mos.
p.tocaré.consejo: Future form with an accent on the last syllable: RE.
p.empiece.consejo: «Cuando» + subjunctive refers to the future: «cuando empiece».
p.entraré.consejo: Future of «entrar». The accent falls on RE.
p.trompeta.consejo: Feminine: «la trompeta». The stress is on PE.
p.ensayaremos.consejo: Future of «ensayar», to rehearse. The y sounds like «y» in «yes».
p.toquen.consejo: The c before e sounds like «k» here: TO-ken.
p.grabará.consejo: Third-person future. The accent is on the last syllable.
p.almacén.consejo: Stress on the last syllable, marked with a tilde: al-ma-THEN.
p.músicos.consejo: The accent on MU shows the stress. Feminine is «música», music.
p.afinan.consejo: Related to «fino», fine. Here it means to get an instrument in tune.
p.instrumentos.consejo: The n sounds before m: ins-tru-MEN-tos. Masculine: «el instrumento».
p.rebota.consejo: The b sounds soft, like «v»: re-BO-ta.
p.contra.consejo: A short word, like «con», with, but meaning «against».
p.convertirse.consejo: The reflexive «se» is attached at the end of the infinitive.
p.teatros.consejo: The e and a are in separate syllables: te-A-tros.
p.repentina.consejo: From «repentino», sudden. The stress is on TI.
p.espectadores.consejo: Family of «espectáculo», show. Stress on DO.
p.melodías.consejo: The stressed i forms its own syllable: me-lo-DI-as.
p.eterno.consejo: «Un segundo eterno» is a second that feels endless.
p.afina.consejo: Third person of «afinar». Compare «afinan», they tune.
p.estudio.consejo: Masculine: «el estudio». The stress is on TU.
p.graba.consejo: Third person singular of «grabar». Stress on GRA.
p.tocar.consejo: The c before a sounds like «k»: to-KAR.
p.partitura.consejo: «La partitura» is the written music. «Sin partitura» means without sheet music.
